outcome: Sensitivity and specificity of ventriculomegaly in predicting CNS anomalies
Positive predictive value (PPV) and negative predictive value (NPV) of ventriculomegaly in predicting CNS anomalies
cohort: 165 patients with 206 CNS anomalies detected on ultrasound at gestational age greater than 14 weeks
finding: The study found that ventriculomegaly is not a strong predictor of CNS anomalies, and a normal ventricle size does not rule out the presence of CNS anomalies.
